senses.gloss:
छेक mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
 1. Tame, domesticated as a bird or beast.
 2. Citizen
town-bred, rakish, buckish, smart, trained in the acuteness and
vice of towns.
 E. छो to cut, affix उकन्, deriv. irr.

छेकोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Indirect speech, insinuation, double entendre, hint, &c.
E. छेक city bred, and उक्ति saying.
